test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following options could be correctly depicted by the Venn diagram given below?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/700edc7931e72a74cdd37dbadddd4d0f8d2b5d6b8965eb9f3fe9d8180a8f5922.png]
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is shown below :

 
• All mothers are women.
 
• Some Doctors are Mothers or Women or both.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bc9ccdac7a813cc30ae7284ac030d19bb2ec550ba52d7956b7323a621d2019e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Mothers, Doctors, Women".**
